body.text: Türkiye's fine-dining map expanded sharply in the [2026 MICHELIN Guide Türkiye](https://guide.michelin.com/tr/en/article/michelin-guide-ceremony/the-michelin-guide-turkiye-reveals-its-2026-restaurant-selection), welcoming Cappadocia for the first time and promoting Urla's Vino Locale to Two Stars. Securing those tables—especially in tiny 12-to-30-seat dining rooms—requires knowing exact booking windows, seasonal closures, and deposit terms. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about)—an independent, client-paid, flat-fee travel advisory run by its two founders in Türkiye ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions.")—we sequence your dining calendar around neighborhood traffic, ferry schedules, and realistic pacing rather than stacking heavy tasting menus back-to-back.
Which Istanbul, Urla and Bodrum restaurants hold Michelin stars in 2026?

The [2026 MICHELIN Guide Türkiye selection](https://guide.michelin.com/tr/en/article/michelin-guide-ceremony/the-michelin-guide-turkiye-reveals-its-2026-restaurant-selection) awards stars to 17 restaurants nationwide: Two Stars to TURK Fatih Tutak (Istanbul) and Vino Locale (Urla), plus 15 One-Star dining rooms—eight in Istanbul, three in İzmir/Urla, three in Bodrum/Muğla, and one in Cappadocia (Revithia in Ürgüp).

body.text: Note that several Bodrum tables operate seasonally (roughly May through October), while Urla's vineyard restaurants—including [Vino Locale](https://www.urlavinolocale.com/) and Teruar Urla—also schedule short winter breaks. Confirm operating dates before locking in domestic flights, especially for off-season trips covered in our [Türkiye winter travel guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide).
How many weeks in advance do top tasting-menu tables open?

Most Turkish Michelin-starred restaurants release tables 30 to 60 days ahead, either on a rolling daily calendar or on the first day of the preceding month. For Two-Star rooms like TURK Fatih Tutak and Vino Locale—or compact counters like Araf, Sankai by Nagaya, and Narımor—book 4 to 8 weeks ahead for Friday and Saturday dinners.

Booking lead times vary sharply by seat count. Narımor in Urla seats roughly a dozen guests across five tables, and Araf in Kadıköy revolves around a tiny open-fire counter, so weekend seats vanish within hours of release. Larger dining rooms like [Mikla](https://www.miklarestaurant.com/reservation) and [Neolokal](https://www.neolokal.com/en/neolokal_en/) often show midweek availability 2 to 3 weeks out, though sunset terrace tables in spring and autumn go faster. If you are combining Istanbul fine dining with a [private Bosphorus yacht](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/private-yacht-istanbul) or a [Cappadocia cave hotel stay](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/luxury-cave-hotels-cappadocia), book your anchor restaurants first and build daily sightseeing around them.
What dress codes, cancellation deposits and wine pairings apply?

Top Turkish tasting-menu restaurants enforce smart-casual or semi-formal dress codes (no beachwear, tracksuits, or flip-flops), require per-person credit card deposits or pre-authorizations, and offer dedicated Turkish wine pairings featuring indigenous grapes like Narince, Emir, Öküzgözü, and Boğazkere alongside international bottles.
Check these reservation rules before confirming your table:

items: Pre-payment and no-show fees: [TURK Fatih Tutak](https://turkft.com/reservation) requires a 9,900 TL per-person deposit within 24 hours of booking (deducted from the final bill), while [Mikla](https://www.miklarestaurant.com/reservation) secures tables with a €35 per-person card guarantee for no-shows.

Dietary restrictions: Micro-seasonal kitchens such as [TURK Fatih Tutak](https://turkft.com/reservation) and [Vino Locale](https://guest.rezervem.com.tr/vino-locale?culture=en-US) state upfront that they cannot accommodate vegan, lactose-free, or celiac/gluten-free tasting menus; notify all other restaurants at least 48 hours ahead.
Age policies: Several tasting rooms set minimum ages (12+ at TURK Fatih Tutak; 15+ at Vino Locale).
Duration: Allow 3 to 3.5 hours for 12–14 course tasting menus (TURK explicitly recommends 200 minutes).
Wine pairings: Ask for the Anatolian pairing—sommeliers like Neolokal's 2026 Michelin Sommelier Award winner Ersin Topkara showcase small-production Turkish estates rarely exported abroad.

body.text: Which non-Michelin local classics deserve a spot alongside fine dining?

Even serious food travelers burn out after three straight nights of multi-hour tasting menus. Balance your itinerary with Türkiye's historic culinary pillars: charcoal-grilled ocakbaşı rooms, lunchtime esnaf lokantası (tradesmen's stew houses), Bosphorus fish taverns (balıkçı), and Michelin Bib Gourmand staples.

The 2026 Guide lists 39 Bib Gourmands across Türkiye—including [Istanbul's Ali Ocakbaşı and Tatbak](https://guide.michelin.com/tr/en/article/michelin-guide-ceremony/two-new-michelin-starred-restaurants-in-the-michelin-guide-istanbul-izmir-mugla), İzmir's Kemal'in Yeri Mülkiyeliler Birliği and Partal Kardeşler Balık Restorant, and Muğla's Mandalya and Mezegi. Pair one starred dinner with a lively Kadıköy market lunch, a Karaköy baklava stop, or a relaxed seaside meze table in Arnavutköy or Gümüşlük.

faq.q: How many Michelin-starred restaurants are in Türkiye in 2026?
faq.a: Seventeen restaurants hold stars in the [2026 MICHELIN Guide Türkiye](https://guide.michelin.com/tr/en/article/michelin-guide-ceremony/the-michelin-guide-turkiye-reveals-its-2026-restaurant-selection): two Two-Star restaurants (TURK Fatih Tutak and Vino Locale) and 15 One-Star restaurants across Istanbul, İzmir, Bodrum/Muğla, and Cappadocia.

faq.q: Which restaurant in Türkiye earned Two Michelin Stars in 2026?
faq.a: Vino Locale in Urla (İzmir), led by Chef Ozan Kumbasar and Seray Kumbasar, ascended to Two Michelin Stars in the 2026 selection, joining Istanbul's TURK Fatih Tutak.

faq.q: Are Bodrum's Michelin-starred restaurants open in winter?
faq.a: Most Bodrum fine-dining venues—including resort-based kitchens like Maçakızı—close or reduce hours between late October and April. Always verify seasonal dates before booking winter Aegean travel.

faq.q: Is tipping included at Michelin-starred restaurants in Türkiye?
faq.a: Many fine-dining restaurants in Istanbul and Bodrum add a 10%–12.5% service charge directly to the bill. Check your receipt before leaving an additional tip.

faq.q: Can vegetarian or gluten-free guests dine at Türkiye's starred restaurants?
faq.a: Some One-Star restaurants adapt menus with 48 hours' notice, but strict tasting-menu kitchens like TURK Fatih Tutak and Vino Locale cannot accommodate vegan, lactose-free, or celiac diets.

faq.q: Do I need a car to reach Urla's Michelin-starred restaurants from İzmir?
faq.a: Yes—or a private driver. Urla's starred dining rooms (Vino Locale, OD Urla, Teruar Urla, Narımor) sit 40–55 minutes west of İzmir city center along rural vineyard roads where late-night taxis are scarce.
